feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. The candidate is the iteration 5 design (kp 2.0, search_right, base_speed 1.0, ki 0.3, kd 0.1, sensors at x = -0.04, -0.015, 0, 0.015, 0.04, score 75.779, the best raced so far) with one change: sensor_size from 0.012 to 0.016. The evidence for this test is that kp changes alone have not removed the failure. Across iterations 4, 5 and 6, kp 2.5, 2.0 and 1.6 all ended with one line-loss event and max_error of about 0.063 to 0.067 m, above the 0.06 m limit. Oscillation stayed low (0.13 to 0.16), so the robot is drifting to an edge rather than weaving. Iteration 2 also showed that widening the outer sensors to x = ±0.04 barely moved the result, so the outer-sensor blind zone has not yet been tested with a larger footprint. Iteration 6 (kp 1.6) lowered progress on every track, so kp 2.0 remains the best gain. The candidate is valid and differs from the best raced design by one field, so it is a clean test. Read the next race this way. (1) If progress is equal to or higher than iteration 5 on the oval and s-bend, and max_error falls toward or below 0.06 m, the larger footprint extends edge detection and H9 is supported. Then test a wider outer span. (2) If progress falls or the signal becomes noisy (more line-loss events or higher oscillation), the 16 mm footprint blurs the centre reading and the 12 mm footprint should be kept. Then test a different damping lever, not more sensor changes. (3) If max_error stays near 0.063 m whatever the footprint, the limit is not sensing and the next lever is kd or base_speed. Keep the iteration 5 gains so the sensor effect can be attributed cleanly.
requested_changes: Race as written. If progress is at least as high as iteration 5 (oval about 0.29, s-bend about 0.15) and max_error or line_loss_events improve, keep sensor_size 0.016 and widen the outer sensors to x = -0.05 and +0.05 with the other three unchanged, since the 16 mm footprint should keep the tape visible further out.

If progress falls or line_loss_events rises with sensor_size 0.016, revert sensor_size to 0.012 and keep kp 2.0 (iteration 5, 75.779). Then test kd from 0.1 to 0.2 to damp the drift toward the edge, since iteration 6 showed that lowering kp reduced progress.

If max_error stays near 0.063 m on every track whatever the footprint, stop changing sensing and test base_speed 1.1 with search_right and kp 2.0, since iterations 3 and 4 showed that speed trades progress between the oval and the bend tracks.
